title: Oxygen Cross-Probe of the History Topography Quotient
status: CROSS-PROBE TOPOGRAPHIC VISIBILITY CLOSED; STRICT PARTITION INVARIANCE FALSE; COMMON H/O LATE BASIN RECOVERED
ruling: The E044 History topography is visible through independently mounted Oxygen activation maps, but the exact quotient partition is not invariant under probe weighting. Oxygen mean-absolute coarsens the basin entrance, L2 matches the substrate stabilization at depth 6, and max-absolute retains one extra transition step. All seven H/O views distinguish E0-E4 and all stabilize by E7, establishing a common cross-probe late basin and probe-robust early History distinction without claiming identical readout classes.
